community_learning.chapter_cases_summary: Apply prior skills to real complex scenarios across domains, orchestration patterns, and system boundaries.
community_learning.chapter_cases_topics: Science agents / Lean / AlphaZero / Multi-agent / Safety architecture / Automation pipelines
